delay_observed.measurement_units: pixels in manually rectified 320x156 research crops; not hardware pixels
delay_observed.range_circle_observation: Selected ring and centre remain stable during this speed sweep. Range changes select different ring sizes/centres.
delay_observed.input_behavior: Closing input stops fresh delay injection; dry remains and previously captured feedback decays.
delay_observed.fidelity_behavior: The demonstration compares similar echo timing with low-range/slow-speed and higher-range/faster-speed settings; the former is darker/rate-reduced.

cwo_observed.signal_behavior: Lower and upper sideband endpoints, both at intermediate positions. Feedback zero leaves processed sound; raising it also introduces original sound.
cwo_observed.visual_observation: Internal coloured mechanism changes orientation; exact timing/binding cannot be recovered from this recording.

implementation_inferences: CWO wheel/flow rate interpolation, feedback particles and sideband chamber cue are original UI choices, not recovered animation code.
CWO feedback-to-dry gain curve is a bounded interpolation, not measured from hardware.
Delay slow-clock colour uses a prefiltered hold model, not a recovered firmware buffer implementation.
